author: Tynvale
body:
What is DTA?

At the moment, I wouldn't be surprised if most of you were saying to yourself, "What's DTA?" Well it is a new gamemode idea I have for the server and so I made a map for it; and if the gamemode is denied I am submitting this as a 4 team DTM.

This is how I was thinking DTA could work:

Name: I'm not set on a name yet, but maybe DTA (Destroy the Altar)
Teams: 2 or more
Objective: So every team would have an "altar" that has an obsidian. The goal is to destroy the other teams, and when a teams alter is destroyed that team cannot respawn. So it is kind of like a DTM map, that gradually becomes elimination.
Pros: It gives a reason to defend and also to rush, it will be pretty competitive and I don't think games would end in like 5 minutes. It is unique and unheard of on other servers. It also gives teams a chance to work well together and could maybe work well in tournaments.
Cons: Games have the potential to go for a very long time, but if you have good rushers and attackers you can eliminate a team strategically. I also don't know if this is possible with YAML, since I don't know anything about YAML!

Now for the actual map details:

Map Name: Sanctum
Map Creator: Tynvale
Teams: 10 v 10 v 10 v 10
Map Download: PM me on Skype if you want it!
YAML: I don't know any YAML so if someone could make one for me I would be very appreciative. Also I would love to see if my gamemode idea is possible in YAML and test it out!
Images: http://imgur.com/a/6yP2c

replies.author: Tynvale
replies.body:
Really, this is like eggwars but changed to adapt to a more competitive feel. There are no generators, you can actually make a good defence and it has more players with less teams. I have to agree with et though; the player count is going to be changed for 10 players at team, totalling to 40 players that can play.

EDIT: I think I originally posted this idea before egg wars was a thing. I decided to make a new post for it though since I finished the map. The thing that bugs me about this though is that if we kept the idea and went with it when it was first suggested, we could be having much more players on the server considering how popular Eggwars got :/
